title: Instructor Standards and Named-Instructor Requests Across the Snowsports School Range
content:
The collective assigns every Snowsports School session an instructor carrying at least the certification level the product calls for. On some products a household may ask for a named instructor, and where the product carries such a request a fee is published for delivering the product with that instructor.

## 1. Certification assigned to each product

The minimum instructor certification level the collective assigns is 1 on the All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson, 2 on the Mountain Explorers Group Lesson, the Mountain Cubs Group Lesson and the Semi-Private Coaching Session, 3 on the Six-Week Development Programme and the Private Instruction Full Day, and 4 on the Elite Performance Camp.

## 2. Adaptive certification

No product of the Snowsports School range requires the assigned instructor to hold adaptive certification.

## 3. Named-instructor requests and their fee

| Product | Named instructor may be asked for | Named-instructor fee (USD) | Minimum certification level | Adaptive certification required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson | no | 0.00 | 1 | no |
| Mountain Explorers Group Lesson | no | 0.00 | 2 | no |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson | no | 0.00 | 2 | no |
| Six-Week Development Programme | no | 0.00 | 3 | no |
| Semi-Private Coaching Session | yes | 75.00 | 2 | no |
| Private Instruction Full Day | yes | 125.00 | 3 | no |
| Elite Performance Camp | yes | 0.00 | 4 | no |

The named-instructor fee is the fee in USD for delivering the product with a named instructor the household asked for.

## 4. Readings of the schedule

- Three products carry a named-instructor request: the Semi-Private Coaching Session, the Private Instruction Full Day and the Elite Performance Camp. Of those three, two carry a fee, at 75.00 USD and 125.00 USD, and the Elite Performance Camp carries the request at 0.00 USD.
- The four products on which a named instructor may not be asked for all show a fee of 0.00 USD.
- The certification level assigned rises with the product: the Elite Performance Camp, at level 4, is the only product in the range taught at that level.
